articles.title: Two Giant Black Holes May Be Heading for a Crash
articles.summary: Scientists found clues that two giant black holes are circling each other and could merge in as little as 100 years.

articles.title: How Ancient People in Japan Adapted After a Huge Eruption
articles.summary: A study shows some ancient communities in Japan shrank after a giant eruption 7,300 years ago, while others moved, adapted and grew.

articles.title: AI Helps Scientists Understand How Cells Talk
articles.summary: MIT scientists built an AI model called IRIS that reads the chemical messages cells send as a body develops.
